panels.description: Lock enters the maker room with two indistinct clerks. Alex and Lina stand beside the purifier; keep the clerks unrecognizable and leave upper space.
A public notice marks the contributors for access review. Show the notice beside the purifier casing and leave it unobstructed.
Suri and Jalen stand together on one side of the bench, watching Lock's document without reaching for it. Keep only these two named makers visible; leave upper third clear.
Ren stands with Alex at the public registry terminal. Alex opens the record while Ren watches; leave upper space for the names.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: The review begins in one hour.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Lina Vey. Suri Anik. Jalen Orr. Ren Okafor. Alex Phantum.
